contract_repair_2026_09_24_v2.purpose: Formal V1.2 -> Sanity serialization contract (05-sanity/contract/sanity-serialization-contract.md), validated against a 48-document fixture built from existing five-school records before being applied to the full dataset. Found and fixed two systemic bugs beyond post_repair_2026_09_24 above.
bugs_fixed: extension_metadata present but fully contentless (blank note, empty fields, no proposed_v1_2_fields) still emitted and still tripped Rule.required() in Studio -- 7 of 50 populated blocks were exactly this, plus 21 more with a real note but an empty fields map that also tripped Rule.required() on fields alone. Fixed: note/fields no longer over-strictly required (NON_ENFORCED_REQUIRED), and the whole block is omitted when genuinely contentless.

VerificationRecord.proposed_value and ChangeRecord.{previous,proposed}_value are declared as untyped 'any value' ({}) in the JSON Schema (confirmed: the ONLY three such properties in the whole schema) and real data populates them with every JSON primitive shape (string/number/boolean/null/object/array) -- the generator defaulted this to a plain Sanity string field, the same [object Object] risk as extension_metadata.fields, for any object/array-shaped proposed value (confirmed present: gb-university-of-oxford-vr-08/-11/-12). Fixed with a new deterministic anyValueBox {value, value_type} shape.
